data.title: Bürgergeld approval notice (Bewilligungsbescheid)
data.summary: Jobcenter Beispiel-Oderland approved Bürgergeld (basic income support) for Ronny Musterspree for the period 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027, amounting to €1,041.30 per month, of which €478.30 covers housing and heating costs.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter has granted your benefit for a full year at the stated monthly amount. The heating cost portion is provisional, so you must send your landlord's 2025 utility cost statement (Nebenkostenabrechnung) by the date given in the letter. If you disagree with any part of this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. If you miss it, the decision becomes final. No action is otherwise needed for the monthly payment itself.

key_facts.quote: Ihr monatlicher Anspruch beträgt 1.041,30 €; darin sind 478,30 € für Unterkunft und Heizung enthalten.
